row:
LIFE FORCE CHIROPRACTIC + WELLNESS is a family wellness centre in Surrey, BC just south of Vancouver. Our team, led by Dr. Robin Randhawa, is committed to providing holistic solutions to address your unique needs, whether you are experiencing Back Pain, Neck Pain, Headaches, or even Muscular Tightness. We also specialize in Chiropractic Treatments for Pregnant Women as well as Paediatric Chiropractic Care.

Our Non-Invasive Treatments are customized to the individual and may include:
 +  Webster Technique + Torque Release Adjustments + Diversified Technique 
 +  Custom Foot Orthotics + Spinal & Postural Screenings + Lifestyle Advice 

To schedule a consultation, you can book directly through our website: www.lifeforcechirowell.com

Life Force Chiropractic + Wellness | #201 – 15850 24 Ave, Surrey, BC V3S 0G1

» YOUTUBE:  https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCZgxFygDzWIx2dFvQG7TOHQ/
» FACEBOOK:  https://www.facebook.com/lifeforcechirowell/
» TWITTER:  https://twitter.com/LifeForce_Chiro
